title: Who Blames Whom in a Crisis? Detecting Blame Ties from News Articles Using Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the extraction of 'blame ties' (who blames whom) from news articles using NLP techniques like BiLSTM and ELMo. Although blame is a concept related to societal values and morality, the paper is an information extraction study and does not systematically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethics, or moral reasoning frameworks.
